title: provision request
description: Always filed by the agent (protocol §7.5 two-stage provisioning, §7.4 issuance). Present lane: the landing page hands the wallet only `code`; the page origin carries no authority. Identity stage, then grants stage, under one code; the chosen identity must satisfy `grantor` when pinned. Delivered to the agent's pickup only.

pairing.description: The device-grant pairing (protocol §7.4); shape per agent-provisioning-and-grant-api.md.

oneOf.$comment: Filed form. Artefact: device cert, then warrants (or none with reason grants_denied).
